verdict.rationale: AvaTax explicitly supports product taxability differences, exemption logic, and jurisdiction-specific rules (avalara-docs-14), offers AI-powered tax code recommendations (avalara-docs-7), and can explain 'how and why tax was calculated' with jurisdiction/sourcing/exemption breakdowns (avalara-docs-28), which speaks to the 'research visible' requirement. However, bundled-offering taxability (mixed digital/physical or service bundles) is never explicitly addressed, and there's no independent/hands-on evidence confirming accuracy on hard SaaS taxability edge cases. Missing for 10: explicit bundled-offering taxability handling, independent verification of correctness on hard SaaS/digital-goods edge cases, deeper detail on how research/citations are surfaced beyond a general AI explain feature.
